grammar.label: present simple for timetables and schedules
grammar.form: present simple with a future time expression

explanation.en: For timetables — trains, planes, cinemas — English uses the present simple, even about the future.
explanation.uz: Jadval haqida (poyezd, samolyot, kino) ingliz tilida kelasi zamon emas, ODDIY HOZIRGI zamon ishlatiladi.

grammar.negative_example: The train will leave at six. (from a timetable)

l1_notes.uz: Bu faqat rasmiy jadvallar uchun — shaxsiy rejalar uchun emas.

grammar.label: present continuous for future arrangements
grammar.form: be + -ing with a future time expression
grammar.meaning: an arrangement fixed with someone else

explanation.en: Use the present continuous when the time and place are already agreed with another person.
explanation.uz: Vaqti va joyi boshqa odam bilan kelishilgan reja uchun.

grammar.positive_example: I am meeting the doctor at four.
grammar.negative_example: I meet the doctor at four.

grammar.label: prepositions of time — extended
grammar.form: during, for, since, until, by, from … to, between
grammar.meaning: periods, points and limits in time

explanation.en: for = how long; since = the starting point; until = up to that moment; by = not later than.
explanation.uz: for = qancha vaqt; since = boshlanish nuqtasi; until = shu paytgacha; by = eng kechi.

exponents.text: I'm afraid I can't make it on Friday.
Could we change it to Sunday?
It's a small town in the north of the country.
There's a park and two schools.
It's quiet but there isn't much to do.
It's about two hours from Tashkent.

functions.label: Asking for and giving directions in detail

exponents.text: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
Go straight on for about two hundred metres.
Take the second turning on the left.
It's opposite the bank, next to the pharmacy.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Look at this timetable. The train to Samarkand leaves at seven in the morning.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Seven? That is very early. When does it arrive?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: At half past nine. It is fast.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: And what are you doing on Sunday?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I am going to the old city. Aziz is coming with me.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Are you staying in a hotel?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Yes, I am staying two nights near a big monument.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Take your camera. The cathedral there is beautiful.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I am taking a small backpack, nothing heavy.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Good. The bus terminal is closed, so the train is better.
